description: YouTube Video Comments: the public comments on one YouTube video by id or URL. Per comment the text, author channel handle, verification, likes, reply count, time and link in the shared social schema; next_cursor gives the next page. Audience feedback and sentiment research. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

video.description: The video: a YouTube video id (11 characters) or a youtube.com/watch?v=, youtube.com/shorts/, youtube.com/live/ or youtu.be/ URL.
